author: Sarah L.
title: Our agency runs on it
text: We moved 14 client projects over in a weekend. The board view and time tracking just work.

author: Dev Patel
title: Lost two days of data
text: After the Tuesday update our boards showed old data and two days of time entries vanished. We invoice clients from this. Unacceptable and we are considering legal action.

author: Mia R.
title: Price went up without notice
text: Our plan went from 39 to 59 euros per month and I only found out from the invoice. At least send an email first.

author: Jonas K.
title: Good but slow on big boards
text: Great features. Boards with more than 500 cards take ages to load.

author: Elena G.
title: Onboarding is confusing
text: The product is fine once you get it, but importing from our old tool took three attempts and the docs did not match the screens.

author: Marc D.
title: Support is excellent
text: Asked about a custom report and got a working answer in 20 minutes. Rare.

author: Chiara B.
title: Impossibile cancellare
text: Voglio disdire l'abbonamento annuale rinnovato ieri e mi dite che non posso avere il rimborso. Mi sembra scorretto, valuto una segnalazione al garante.

author: Tom H.
title: Missing feature
text: Still no recurring tasks. Every competitor has them. We are evaluating alternatives.

author: Lena S.
title: Client reports are great
text: The client report export saves me two hours every Friday. My clients love the look.

author: Omar A.
title: Data privacy concern
text: I found that any member of a workspace can see every client's files, even guests. Is this GDPR compliant? I want to know what data you store about me and I will contact the data protection authority.

author: Julia P.
title: Solid
text: Does what it says. Mobile app could be faster.

author: Ravi N.
title: Outage during a deadline
text: The app was down for three hours on the morning of our launch. Status page said all fine. We lost a client demo.

author: Sophie M.
title: Switched from a big name
text: Cheaper and simpler than the tool we left. Setup took one afternoon.

author: Luis F.
title: Buena herramienta, soporte lento
text: La herramienta es buena pero tardaron cuatro días en responder a mi pregunta sobre facturación.

author: Hannah W.
title: Invoices are wrong
text: Our invoices show the wrong VAT number even after we fixed it in Settings twice.

author: Greg T.
title: Love it
text: Simple and fast, my team adopted it in a day.

author: Nina V.
title: Scam billing
text: You charged my card for a plan I cancelled in July. This is a scam and I have disputed the payment with my bank.

author: Paolo C.
title: Ottimo prodotto
text: Le board sono chiare e il tracciamento del tempo è preciso. Mi piacerebbe l'integrazione con il mio software di fatturazione.

author: Karl B.
title: Dokumentation veraltet
text: Die Dokumentation passt nicht mehr zur aktuellen Version, wir haben viel Zeit mit der Einrichtung verloren.

author: Amy S.
title: Great for small agencies
text: Guests can comment on tasks without a licence. That alone is worth it.

author: Ivo R.
title: Export does not work
text: Export to CSV times out for projects with more than a year of data. I need this for my accountant.

author: Dana M.
title: Average
text: Does the basics. Nothing wrong, nothing that stands out.

author: Felix O.
title: Rude reply from support
text: I reported a bug and was told I was using the product wrong. I was following your own tutorial.

author: Anna B.
title: Fast updates
text: New release every two weeks and they actually fix what users ask for.

author: Marta E.
title: Très utile
text: Très bon outil pour le suivi du temps. Il manque un mode hors ligne.

author: Chris L.
title: Permissions are clumsy
text: Setting per-project permissions takes too many clicks and I got it wrong twice.

author: Ben J.
title: Account hacked?
text: Someone logged into my account from another country and changed the owner email. I could not reach anyone for a day. I am talking to a journalist about this.

author: Ella N.
title: Recommended
text: Clean interface, reliable, fair price.

author: Rob F.
title: Needs better search
text: Search ignores comments and attachments, so I cannot find anything I wrote last quarter.

author: Irene Q.
title: Annual plan trap
text: I wanted to downgrade my annual plan mid-year and was told I have to wait for renewal. Should be clearer when buying.

author: Pavel S.
title: Excellent migration
text: Support helped us move from spreadsheets, even built a template for our workflow.

author: Lucy T.
title: Slow and buggy
text: Tasks duplicate when I drag them between columns. Reported it twice, no fix.

author: Dario M.
title: Prezzo giusto
text: Buon software per il prezzo, supporto cortese.

author: Zoe H.
title: Good, but the app logs me out
text: Keeps logging me out on the phone, annoying but the web version is fine.

author: Nick A.
title: Our clients noticed
text: Clients said our reports look far more professional since we switched.
